notes.title: Small patch (not final)
notes.notes: -Removed temp. Kept the icon and it still reacts but there wont be any effect that comes with it.

notes.title: Very minor patch
notes.notes: Fixed pause menu on tutorial and added some more neon signs for the nightime drive level.

notes.title: Pause menu fixed
notes.notes:
The priority was the save system.
But i eventually got around to fixing the pause menu. The new pause menu won't reload the level on resume anymore, instead it will take you right back to the position you were previously in, this also makes the load time to options menu alot shorter.
It should hopefully work perfectly.

I wont be patching for awhile after this since i've burntout alot these past two weeks working 2 or sometimes 5 hours a day on the game. But i'll probably be back soon with more fixes.

notes.title: Biggest patch yet, whole lotta everything.
notes.notes: Remade the save system from scratch because it didn't work previously. Added more help in tutorial text, and some arrows to hint what to do. Completely revamped the visual style of the game, enjoy.

notes.title: General Patch 2
notes.notes: Big changes: Removed Steam achievements... Sadly they were just bugging the game too much, i tried to make them work. I bug fixed for a week just trying to stop them from completely destroying the game's save system. But it just wasn't working, i'll  maybe add them back one day if GodotSteam gets fixed but for now it's just to messy and unreliable. Change 2: I added some text so the game's mechanics are more clear and understandable in the tutorial. Change 3: I fixed some text inconsistencies with NPC dialog. Change 4: Made the tutorial a bit easier. That's a wrap on Patch 2.

notes.title: Release patch 1
notes.notes:
Made download smaller, added new crosshairs to levels that needed them, fixed a bug in the Options Menu, Changed text in Options Menu to make it more visible, deleted some content that was scrapped but still in the game, removed Options Menu preferences saving which were bugging a ton of the save system, now options preferences don't save when game is quit but atleast the game isn't broken, made the game free.

Coming soon: Fixing more bugs with save system and maybe Mac port.
